additional_info.subject: ID0392274-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002550]-Feature request for Credit card payment CRM:01410001263
additional_info.body:
Hello Oliver Zimmermann,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Shreyas
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset
:
AH5057DC001
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
MP / R0 170002550
Problem Description
: Feature request for Credit card payment
Troubleshooting
: I would request you to provide some more information regarding your feature requests.
1. The video link: We have gone through the video, and we can see that the customer is able to charger with their creditcard without any issues, however, we can see that they are unable download their transaction receipt. Since this receipt is managed by the payment gateway provider, we do not how we can help in downloading the receipt.
2. “All 3 chargers have a different user flow when paying with a credit card (videos were recorded) despite identical firmware” : Could you please provide us the video? We have seen only 1 video on the ticket.
3. "Some instructions are in English despite the German language being selected (Tariff is not available)" : We will provide this feedback to the product team regarding this feature request. It would be helpful if you could provide us some screenshots or a video showcasing this issue.
4. "
Why are there no visual instructions for the customer after selecting a credit card, like with RFID, so that they know where to hold the card" : Similar to point 3, we will provide this feedback to the product team for the feature request.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0392274
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shreyas Sathe
